parts.text: Because you have completed 14 months of continuous service (exceeding the 12-month minimum), you are eligible for **16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave** within 12 months of birth or adoption placement [DOC-US-PARENTAL-2026#sec-3.1].
You are eligible for 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave because you have completed at least 12 consecutive months of service [DOC-US-PARENTAL-2026#sec-3.1].

property.description: States 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave accurately based on the 12-month tenure requirement.
